name: episodic_hard
description: Stricter synthetic benchmark for GSW-style episodic memory. It stresses forward-falling questions, spatiotemporal anchor coupling, role/state separation, action typing, and MemoryOS-style narrative/segment reuse without requiring network or LLM calls.

scenarios.name: forward_falling_question_late_anchor
scenarios.description: The first observation names the actor and action but omits time/place; the second supplies the missing anchors. The open question should be answered through shared entity overlap.
